name: @mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit
description: MGPL Diagnostics money layer for the backend: GST engine and GSTR-1 / GSTR-3B data, B2B receivables and statements, credit notes, collection-centre settlements with configurable TDS, day-end cash closing, bank reconciliation, lock dates, year-end close and CSV exports. A library on db-kit's repositories; no server, no GraphQL.
